summary: React context provider for the home-page bulletin (news) list. It seeds state from the SSR-provided value {bulletins, total}, then on mount calls getBulletinList(lang, 1, 10); when code === 0 it stores data.list filtered through SiteUtils' hidden-bulletin check (cid vs SiteConfig.hide_bulletin_dict for the current lang), stores data.total and sets frontBulletinReady = true, otherwise logs '拉取公告列表失败' and shows Toast.message(t('toast.networkError')). The memoized context value is {frontBulletinReady, bulletins, total}; useBulletinList reads it.
